name: Polite Decline
summary: Turns down duel requests and group invitations from strangers without a fuss, while friends and guild mates still get through.
logoPrompt: A closed arched wooden door with an ornate iron ring knocker, and a red velvet rope on two small brass posts in front of it
description: **Polite Decline quietly says no to duel requests and group invites from people you do not know, so random popups stop getting in your way.**
## Features
- Cancels duel requests from strangers and hides the popup.
- Declines group invitations from strangers and hides the popup.
- Friends, Battle.net friends and guild mates always get through.
- Your own allow list for anyone else you want to hear from.
- One chat line per declined request, with a count for this session.
## How to use
Install it, nothing else is needed. Type `/pd` (or `/politedecline`) to see the settings and all commands.
## In detail
### Auto decline duels and group invites

When a duel request or a group invite arrives, Polite Decline checks who sent it. If it is a stranger, the duel is cancelled or the invite declined, and the game's popup is closed right away. Both halves are on by default and can be switched off on their own.
### Who still gets through

Anyone on your friends list, your Battle.net friends and the members of your guild are never declined. For a duel the game only sends a name, so Battle.net friends are recognised by the character they are playing right now, and guild mates by the guild roster, which the addon asks the server for at login. If a lookup cannot answer, for example because the roster has not arrived yet, the request is let through instead of being declined by mistake.
### The allow list

Add anyone else with `/pd allow Name`. A name without a realm is allowed on every realm; `Name-Realm` allows only that realm. Upper and lower case do not matter, and realm names match with or without spaces, dashes or apostrophes.
### Commands
- `/pd` – shows which halves are on and whether quiet mode is on.
- `/pd duels on` or `off` – declining duels from strangers.
- `/pd invites on` or `off` – declining group invites from strangers.
- `/pd quiet on` or `off` – stops or brings back the chat lines.
- `/pd allow Name`, `/pd unallow Name` and `/pd list` – keep and show the allow list.
## Good to know
- Works on Retail only. No combat data, it only acts when a request arrives.
- It does not touch trade requests, guild invitations or pet battle duels.
- The count in the chat line starts again at every login or reload.
- The addon is in English.
- Settings and the allow list are saved for your whole account and kept until you change them.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
